# Oneko cat

Adapted from https://github.com/ramxcodes/sleek-portfolio (public/oneko/oneko.js and oneko.gif), originally https://github.com/adryd325/oneko.js.

The local sprite retains the reference animations. The integration adds React lifecycle cleanup, background-tab pausing, touch-only and reduced-motion handling, absolute asset paths, and a layer below dialogs and reading controls. No external runtime scripts or dependencies are loaded.
